NIL Compliance & Financial FAQ

Do NIL earnings count as taxable income?

Yes. NIL income must be reported. Set aside 25–30% for taxes.

Can my school help manage my NIL deals?

You are responsible for understanding your contracts.

What if I receive free products instead of cash?

Non-cash NIL compensation is still taxable.
